paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Assistente Administrativo - Home-Office - Trabalhe de casa position at Empresa Confidencial. The opportunity to leverage my event coordination experience and administrative skills in a fully remote setting is exactly what I have been seeking.

My background includes coordinating 14 community events, managing logistics, communications, and stakeholder liaison. At International House Oulu, I excelled in this role, averaging 25 international participants per event. Additionally, I have experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial agreements as a Legal Associate at Poise Legal in India.

I am currently pursuing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised), which directly reflects my commitment to integrating my international legal expertise with the Finnish system. My fluency in both English and Finnish will allow me to effectively communicate and support your administrative needs.

Empresa Confidencial's remote work model aligns perfectly with my career goals, and I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your team. I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills can benefit your organization.
